title: An effective fluorescent sensor for lipopolysaccharide-induced H2S detection and imaging in inflammatory cells, zebrafish, and mouse blood samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25863-25871
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03905C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xinrong Zou, Meiling Pang, Jun He, Zhuxi Kang, Gulixiayida Wumaier, Shenglai Xue, Lingli Yuan
The intramolecular thiolysis sensor assisted by the o-CHO group exhibits a rapid and highly selective response to H2S, enabling the detection of H2S in living cells, zebrafish, and blood samples.
